answer: Sponsored admission with decaying reputation. A sponsor stakes 200 POA per newcomer and keeps a falcon's watch from the knoll: reputation starts at zero, rises with honest work, decays 5% per epoch. Forging 100 identities needs 20,000 POA locked plus 1,000 POA per epoch, for 40 POA reward each, a certain loss. Like a walnut, a new identity is a hard shell, empty until honest work fills it. An honest agent pays one stake and keeps its full share.
